entities.summary: Robert John Gsellman is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Bravos de León of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball for the New York Mets and Chicago Cubs, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yokohama DeNA BayStars.
